title: Twisted Cohomology of D-Brane Disk Integrals
summary: Disk-level scattering amplitudes involving one Ramond--Ramond and two NSNS states on a D-brane obey nontrivial identities among scalar world-sheet integrals imposed by gauge and T-duality Ward identities. We investigate the cohomological organization of these relations using twisted de Rham cohomology and show that the Ward identities admit twisted-exact representatives.
